messages:
Ana (partnerships): Heads-up — marketplace intake came in for Acme Corp (MK-4321). Integrator 'NovaSys' shows up on the intake form as the contact. Do we have a quick rule for who claims these? :thinking:
Kai (partnerops-bot): New marketplace intake #MK-4321 created via GCP Marketplace by contact sam@acme.com. Attached: purchase-intent form, intro email.
Devon (sales): I was on the discovery call last week. ACV looks like $180-240k depending on infra scope. AM territory falls under me, but NovaSys did the initial PoC intro. What does policy say re: SI-introduced marketplace leads?
Li (solutions): If SI introduced the customer and there's an intro email / meeting, standard is to let the SI claim opportunity capture but we coordinate on technical/contracting work. Recommend 50/50 credit split for co-sell unless SI brings full contract (then they own).
Ana (partnerships): Proposed quick checklist to resolve: 1) Confirm SI introduction evidence (email/meeting). 2) Map account to ACV band. 3) File claim with partnerops (include meeting notes + intro email). 4) PM/AM and partnerops sign-off for >$200k. Code snippet for claim form (paste into partnerops form):
```
claim_id: CL-998
intake_id: MK-4321
si: NovaSys
evidence: meeting-notes.pdf, intro-email.eml
proposed_split: 50/50
notes: PoC done by SI last month, Redwood to scope runtime commit
```
Devon (sales): @Marco can you confirm approval flow for ~200k cases? Also, do we have a 30-day hold period after claim submission?
Marco (sales-lead): Yep — for deals near the $200k threshold, I review evidence and confirm territory rules. We have a 30-day claim window once partnerops marks the claim pending. If contested, we schedule a 15-min triage with SI, AM, and partnerships. Add links to meeting notes and the SI intro thread.
Ana (partnerships): I'll open the claim now and tag everyone. Also adding a note: please include any proof of SI technical involvement to avoid later disputes. cc: @Devon @Li
Devon (sales): Thanks — I will prep the joint intro deck and loop in AM for next Tue demo. Can someone add an explicit "no-poach" note in the claim? Prefer it in the claim metadata.
Kai (partnerops-bot): Claim CL-998 submitted by Ana (partnerships). Status: pending review by Marco. Reminder: attach at least one verifiable SI introduction artifact or claim may be auto-escalated. :white_check_mark:
